cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Lose Something for Me
cards.instruction: Create a loyalty test by asking them to accept a real disadvantage on your behalf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Miss the prize ceremony and come to my tiny opening night. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I know. Coming wouldn't mean much if you had nothing else to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Maybe. I'm trying to discover whether I'm more than the convenient option.

mechanism: A organizes transport and a good seat to make B willing to sacrifice prize attendance for A opening night.
confusable: Unlike inviting a free friend to a show, A knows B would forgo their own honor and uses that as the loyalty test.
comparison: Missing a personal award for theater differs from giving a competitive first turn.
seedUse: D203-b opening night and prize recipient; S02-b takes practical arrangements without removing the genuine sacrificed event.
